_note: Hand-edited. One entry per subscription service. Set monthly_price_usd, source_url, last_verified and verified true for a price to show. Anything with verified false renders as 'Price not confirmed' and is left out of the cheapest-combination maths.

_fields.monthly_price_usd: Number in US dollars per month, or null if not confirmed.
_fields.billing_note: Short line shown under the price, e.g. season pricing or a required bundle.
_fields.carries: Broadcaster codes from the NBA schedule feed that this service gives you.
_fields.affiliate_url: Leave empty until you have a link. When any service on a page has one, that page shows the affiliate disclosure.

rules._note: League Pass blackout rules. The generator reads applies_to to work out coverage; it never hardcodes them. Paste the official League Pass help page into source_url and set verified true once the wording is checked.

blackouts.label: Games shown on a national broadcast are blacked out on League Pass.
Your local team's games are blacked out on League Pass inside its home market.

_broadcaster_codes_seen._note: Every national code the NBA schedule feed used for 2026-27 when this was last checked, with how many regular-season games carried it. Match these strings in a service's carries list. Matching ignores case, spaces and punctuation, so 'NBA TV' and 'NBATV' are the same code.
_broadcaster_codes_seen.unassigned: 303 of 1206 regular-season games carried a national broadcaster, 446 carried a local one and 541 carried neither. The rest fill in as the league publishes them, and the daily build logs the count.
